name: Chartography v1 · No tools
protocol: 100 tasks; no tools; Gemini 3.5 Flash grading, five trials for Anthropic September 22 results.

summary.en: Tests understanding of specialized charts used in professional work.
summary.zh: 测试理解专业工作中特殊图表的能力。

task_format.en: 100 expert-authored chart questions; canonical observations use no tools and the Gemini 3.5 Flash judge.
task_format.zh: 100 道专家编写的图表题；主序列采用无工具条件和 Gemini 3.5 Flash 评分器。

explanation.en: Mean pass@1 against expert answer tolerances. Tool-assisted and older judge configurations must remain separate.
explanation.zh: 依据专家设定的答案容差计算平均 pass@1。有工具结果和旧评分器配置分开记录。
